title.narrative: Ausbildung von Lehrkräften für Primarschulen im Südsudan
Training teachers for primary schools in South Sudan

description.narrative: Access to education is poor in South Sudan. Schools do not have sufficient capacity and many teachers have had no training at all. The aim of the project is to train primary school teachers who are already working or preparing to do so so that they are able to prepare and implement lesson contents in line with the curricula. In addition to these basic teaching tools, they are given skills in using computers, are sensitised to trauma, receive English courses and develop methods that are tailored to the huge class sizes of 80 - 100 pupils.
